fields: L4 Beijing / Chinese New Year (tricycle; Shichahai hutong → Chang'an Avenue → Summer Palace). Same item fields as L3 v3.1. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = Lantern Riddle Stand 灯谜摊 questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = Chang'an Avenue fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Seventeen-Arch Bridge final 十七孔桥终极题 (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 5 riddle-stand + 4 fork + 1 final = 10. Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Lantern riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'). Stems are deduped against all L1–L3 banks (all grades).

questions.explain_zh: 挂在门上的桃木板后来演变成春联。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A tricycle tour costs C = 5 + 4k yuan for k km. What is C when k = 4?
questions.q_zh: 三轮车游胡同的价钱是 C = 5 + 4k 元（k 为千米数），k = 4 时 C 是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Renting a tricycle costs 11 yuan plus 8 yuan per hour. A family pays 75 yuan. How many hours did they ride?
questions.q_zh: 租三轮车先付 11 元，每小时再付 8 元，一家人共付 75 元，骑了几小时？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Renting a tricycle costs 13 yuan plus 5 yuan per hour. A family pays 23 yuan. How many hours did they ride?
questions.q_zh: 租三轮车先付 13 元，每小时再付 5 元，一家人共付 23 元，骑了几小时？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A stall sold 500 red envelopes last year, and sales grew by 25% this year. How many did it sell this year?
questions.q_zh: 一个小摊去年卖了 500 个红包，今年增长 25%，今年卖了多少个？

questions.subject: spring_festival
questions.q_en: A gate near the bridge shows the first line 向阳门第春常在. Which second line completes the couplet?
questions.q_zh: 桥边一扇门上的上联是「向阳门第春常在」。哪一句是它的下联？
questions.explain_en: 向阳门第春常在 / 积善人家庆有余: seven characters each, ending oblique then level.
questions.explain_zh: 向阳门第春常在，积善人家庆有余；各七字，上仄下平。
questions.qtype_zh: 春联知识（对仗/平仄/横批）

questions.subject: beijing
questions.q_en: From the bridge, Flora looks back at the Long Corridor along the shore. Which statement about it is true?
questions.q_zh: Flora 在桥上回望岸边的长廊。关于长廊，哪句话是对的？
choices: It is about 7.28 km long with 27 sections
It is about 728 m long with 273 sections
It is made of ice every winter
choices_zh: 全长约 7.28 千米，共 27 间
全长约 728 米，共 273 间
questions.explain_en: The Long Corridor is 728 m long with 273 sections.
questions.explain_zh: 长廊全长 728 米，共 273 间。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: From the foot of a lantern pole on the bridge, a string runs to a point 16 m along the deck; the pole is 12 m tall. How long is the string from the top of the pole, in metres?
questions.q_zh: 桥上一根灯杆高 12 米，从杆顶拉一根彩绳到桥面上离杆脚 16 米的地方，绳长多少米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A cylindrical lantern on the bridge has radius 3 dm and height 30 dm. Using π ≈ 3.14, what is its volume in dm³?
questions.q_zh: 桥上一个圆柱形灯笼底面半径 3 分米、高 30 分米，π 取 3.14，体积是多少立方分米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A sketch of the bridge's lantern arch is 3 cm wide and 4 cm tall. A similar banner copy is 15 cm wide. How tall is the banner in cm?
questions.q_zh: 桥上灯笼拱门的草图宽 3 厘米、高 4 厘米，放大成相似的横幅后宽 15 厘米，高是多少厘米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The bridge's lantern lighting follows L = 3 + 7n, where n is minutes after sunset. How many lanterns are lit when n = 7?
questions.q_zh: 桥上灯笼按 L = 3 + 7n 依次点亮，n 是日落后的分钟数。n = 7 时亮了多少盏？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On a park map, 1 cm stands for 250 m. The path from the Long Corridor to the Seventeen-Arch Bridge is 7 cm on the map. How many metres is it really?
questions.q_zh: 公园地图上 1 厘米代表 250 米，从长廊到十七孔桥的路在图上长 7 厘米，实际是多少米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A round lantern hanging under the bridge has a diameter of 80 cm. Using π ≈ 3.14, how many cm of gold trim go once around it?
questions.q_zh: 桥下挂着一个直径 80 厘米的圆灯笼，π 取 3.14，绕它一圈的金边要多少厘米？
